titulo: Para (not por) for a precise time or occasion
subtitulo: Vienen para Navidad: for that day, by that date.
regla: Use para (not por) for a specific time, event or deadline: para Navidad, para tu cumpleaños, para el lunes. Por + event = because of it.

bloques.texto: To say **when** something takes place, for a **specific day, event or deadline**, use **para**: **para Navidad**, **para tu cumpleaños**, **para el viernes**.
Compare: **vino para la fiesta** = he came for the day of the party (to be there). **Vino por la fiesta** = he came because of the party (that was the reason).
Tip: **para** points at a date on the calendar.

lista.es: Mis hermanos vienen a la casa ==para== Navidad.
lista.en: My siblings are coming home for Christmas.

lista.es: Te vamos a comprar un reloj ==para== tu cumpleaños.
lista.en: We're going to buy you a watch for your birthday.

lista.es: Nos vamos a Cabo ==para== nuestro aniversario.
lista.en: We're going to Cabo for our anniversary.
I need the report by Monday.
Beto came for the party (to be at it).
Beto came because of the party.

filas.t: Termina la tarea por el viernes.
Termina la tarea para el viernes.

Entrega el reporte para el lunes.
